title: CIVER: Causal Intervention Verification for Reliable Code Review
abstract: arXiv:2610.36010v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Code review is essential for maintaining software repositories by identifying defects, improving code quality, and supporting reliable software evolution. With the growing adoption of LLM-based coding agents, an increasing number of code contributions and repository changes are generated by these agents. Consequently, LLM-based code review agents are becoming increasingly prevalent to evaluate these contributions and maintain software quality. However, LLM reviewers often generate lengthy reviews containing numerous potential issues, many of which are false positives or lack sufficient evidence. These unreliable reviews can mislead developers and downstream coding agents, motivating the need to distinguish actionable findings from unsupported claims. We propose CIVER, a causal intervention-based framework that identifies the core issues underlying code-review findings and distinguishes genuine defects from false positives. CIVER integr

translated_title: CIVER：面向可靠代码评审的因果干预验证
translated_abstract: 代码评审对于维护软件仓库至关重要，它通过识别缺陷、提高代码质量并支持可靠的软件演化发挥作用。随着基于大语言模型（LLM）的编码智能体日益普及，越来越多的代码贡献和仓库变更由这些智能体生成。因此，基于LLM的代码评审智能体正变得越来越普遍，用于评估这些贡献并维护软件质量。然而，LLM评审者常常生成包含大量潜在问题的冗长评审，其中许多是误报或缺乏充分证据。这些不可靠的评审会误导开发者和下游编码智能体，因此亟需区分可操作的发现与缺乏依据的断言。我们提出了CIVER，一个基于因果干预的框架，用于识别代码评审发现背后的核心问题，并区分真实缺陷与误报。CIVER融合……
tldr: CIVER提出了一种基于因果干预的验证框架，通过识别代码评审发现背后的核心问题来区分真实缺陷与误报，从而提升LLM代码评审的可靠性。
en_tdlr: CIVER proposes a causal intervention-based framework that identifies the core issues underlying code-review findings and distinguishes genuine defects from false positives, thereby improving the reliability of LLM-based code review.
